lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from a light-colored dorsal surface to a darker shadowed region immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of lower-intensity, high-luminance blobs visible on the anterior portion and base of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
